headline: Names a federal building and courthouse in Gainesville, Georgia, after the late judge Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the federal building and U.S. courthouse at 121 Spring Street S.E. in Gainesville, Georgia. The new name is the "Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse." It changes only the official name of the building and does not change how the building is used or run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
